How to create the antlr runtime

1. Download the pre-built MacOS Antlr runtime from:
  https://www.antlr.org/download/antlr4-cpp-runtime-4.8-macos.zip
or look for it on here:
  https://www.antlr.org/download.html

2. Unzip the MacOS runtime zip file and move all of the header files to a include/ directory. Keep the .a and .dylib files in a lib/macos/ directory.

3. Download and unzip the complete Antlr source file onto the appropriate linux box for building.

4. Prepare the build enviroment on the linux box by installing/running:
   - sudo yum install libuuid-devel cmake
   - sudo yum install centos-release-scll
   - sudo yum install devtoolset-7-gcc*
   - scl enable devtoolset-7 bash

5. Create the makefile by running: cmake CMakeLists.txt

6. Compile Antlr by running: make

7. Copy the files in the dist/ subdirectory to the Thirdparty/antlr/lib/linux/centos7 directory in the SE repository.
